title: Mystical Peru
short_description: Discover the best of Peru in 7 days through Lima, Paracas, Ica, Huacachina, Cusco, Machu Picchu, Humantay Lake and Rainbow Mountain.
long_description:
Explore the best of Peru on a 7-day, 6-night journey combining history, culture, nature and adventure.

Begin in Lima, discover the marine wildlife of Paracas and the dunes of Huacachina, then continue into the Andes for Cusco, Machu Picchu, Humantay Lake and Rainbow Mountain.
price_note: From USD 519 per person. Transportation, admission tickets and professional guide included. Subject to availability.

days.title: Day 1: Arrival in Lima
days.text: Airport reception and transfer to your accommodation. Depending on arrival time, enjoy Miraflores, its boardwalk, parks and Pacific Ocean views.

days.title: Day 2: Paracas – Ica – Huacachina
days.text: Early departure to Paracas and boat tour of the Ballestas Islands. Continue to Ica for wine tasting and then to Huacachina for dune buggies and sandboarding. Return to Lima.

days.title: Day 3: Lima – Cusco
days.text: Continue the journey to Cusco, with airport reception and hotel transfer. The rest of the day is reserved for acclimatization at approximately 3,400 m above sea level.

days.title: Day 4: Machu Picchu
days.text: Transfer to Ollantaytambo and tourist train to Aguas Calientes. Bus to Machu Picchu for a guided visit on the assigned circuit. Return by train and tourist transport to Cusco.

days.title: Day 5: Humantay Lake
days.text: Early departure, buffet breakfast and a 1.5 to 2-hour hike to Humantay Lake. Time for photos and your guide's explanation, followed by buffet lunch and return to Cusco.

days.title: Day 6: Rainbow Mountain
days.text: Travel to Cusipata, buffet breakfast and a 1.5 to 2-hour hike to Rainbow Mountain – Vinicunca. Lunch and return to Cusco after the visit.

days.title: Day 7: Farewell
days.text: Free time according to your flight schedule, followed by the coordinated transfer to Cusco Airport.
